node.statement: For the finite filtration, dim_reals V=sum_{p=0}^k dim_reals(W_p/W_{p+1}) by telescoping dimensions. Substitution in the trace identity gives Tr(sigma^{*k}:H^k(M;reals)->H^k(M;reals))=(-1)^k dim_reals H^k(M;reals); since k was arbitrary, the asserted formula holds for every k >= 0.
